title: Ephesians
author: Paul the apostle.
date: During Paul's imprisonment, first century A.D.
audience: Believers in Ephesus and surrounding churches.
historicalSetting: Ephesians reveals God's eternal purpose in Christ and calls the church to walk worthy of that grace.
keyVerse: Ephesians 2:8 — "For by grace you have been saved through faith."
christFocus: Ephesians exalts Christ as head over all things and head of the church, showing believers seated, saved, and strengthened in Him.
outline: Grace and God's eternal purpose — Ephesians 1-3
